text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "Dear everyone, How are you all doing? I hope you've been well because I've been super-duper fine!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "I've got some real swell news for you! My debut date for the Twinkle Series has finally been decided!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "I'm gonna do my darndest and do you all proud! I hope you'll all keep watching and cheering me on! Yours truly, Yukino Bijin"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Starting tomorrow, Yukino Bijin and I begin training in earnest for her Twinkle Series debut.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hello, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I just want t'get us started off on the right foot!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: First off, thanks for sign'n me on!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I know I'm still a li'l wet b'hind the ears, but I'll follow all your instructions as best I can!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna do my best!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Look'n forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: By the way, I got a li'l someth'n for you. It's not much, but I hope y'like it.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: My folks gave me a buncha local specialties from Morioka to give out as souvenirs, see!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I recommend the shortbread cookies! They're real soft and tasty!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin is from Morioka. Although a lot of Tracen students are from smaller towns, very few show their roots so strongly.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Don't mention it! Mom and Dad told me t'give you their best wishes too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: The whole village said they'd be cheer'n for me too. It's so encourag'n.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: All their hopes are rid'n on me, so I won't let 'em down!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite everyone's great expectations for her, she doesn't seem nervous at all. Instead, they seem to serve as her motivation to work hard.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: And while I'm at it, I'm gonna make my dream a reality too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: And that dream is t'become a glam'rous city girl!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I wanna be like Gold City—all flashy and cool and strong!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I wanna go out there, duke it out, and make m'self the best Umamusume I can be!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: That way, people won't just treat me like some fad, they'll be real fans! Or that's what I figure, at least!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I understand what she means almost immediately. I decide to see Yukino Bijin back to her dorm, and the moment we step off campus…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fan A
text_block_list.text: Oh! It's Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fans
text_block_list.text: Awww! She's so cute!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wowzers! What's all this?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A group of what appear to be Yukino Bijin's fans are gathered around the school gate. They're all wearing the same T-shirt, which reads…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "Yukino Bijin Fan Club"?! A-a fan club?! For me?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Gee will'kers! My eyes aren't play'n tricks on me, are they?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fans
text_block_list.text: Omigooosh! Listen to her accent! It's so cute! ♪

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what is going on over there? Yukino Bijin hasn't even debuted yet, has she?

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but she's from the countryside, and regional Umamusume are all the rage right now!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: Just think about it. Oguri Cap and Inari One are both from the regional scene, and they've been doing extremely well in their races.

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: That's probably why Yukino Bijin is getting a lot of attention. She totally looks the part too.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the support, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Won't be long now till I fin'lly get to debut! I hope you're all look'n forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fan A
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! I forgot she'll be running in races too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fan B
text_block_list.text: I've never seen her run, but since she's inviting us, we have no choice but to go watch!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Aw golly, you're mak'n me blush! I hope to see you there!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyaaa! She's so adorable! ♪

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Oh, geez… I don't envy her one bit. No way do I want all those eyes on me…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like the buzz around Yukino Bijin is mainly driven by her personality and appearance.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …Ehehe. Am I really that cute?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, no one pays much mind to her running. I know she feels conflicted about that fact, but…

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: You'll be just dandy! Like I said, this trend could be your big opp'rtunity!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I hear you… Since I got all these eyes on me anyway, I gotta do m'best and show 'em what I'm really made of… right?

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Exactly! Do that, and you'll be golden!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Okay! I trust you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (Mifuyu's always so cool. I'm so glad we grew up t'gether. And even when we're apart, we're still doing the same thing—chas'n our dreams.)

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Wow… You know, it just hit me, but you're already at the start'n line for mak'n your dream come true. Looks like you've got a head start on me.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: I've gotta get mov'n! If I wanna go to the figure skating world championship and stand on top of the world, I gotta get practic'n!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: When it comes to skat'n, you're the cat's pajamas! You'll make your dream come true for sure!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Thanks! I've really gotta focus on mak'n some tangible progress from here on out. Some people our age have already proven their weight in salt, twice over!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: And yet my jumps still haven't gotten any better! I've gotta keep practicing till I can nail 'em every time.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You're gonna be killer, Mifuyu! I just know you'll get those jumps down pat!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Haha, you think? Thanks, Yuki. Let's get out there and make our dreams come true!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Righty-roo!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (The folks back home, Trainer, Mifuyu… Everybody's cheer'n for me.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (Plus, I've got fans now too. I've gotta strike while the iron's hot and prove m'self while people are watch'n!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: All right! First things first, I've gotta do well in my debut race! Time t'show 'em what I got!
